exposure: Uterine artery angiography (UA) classification (Type 1: complete staining, Type 2: partial staining)
outcome: Clinical success/failure of primary uterine artery embolization (UAE) for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
cohort: 63 consecutive patients who underwent uterine artery embolization (UAE) for severe postpartum hemorrhage (PPH).
finding: Uterine artery angiography (UA) classification was found to be an independent predictive factor for the clinical success rate of primary UAE for PPH, with type 1 (complete staining) having a higher success rate (90.9%) than type 2 (partial staining) (61.0%).
